calculation_handling.description: A lawfully existing architectural element of a place of worship (minaret, steeple) may keep its lawful height above the permitted maximum height; the value is the as-built height of that element, which the lot data does not hold.
calculation_handling.gaps: as-built height of the architectural element

units.disclosure: This exemption lets a lawfully existing place of worship keep the lawful height of an architectural element such as a minaret or steeple even where it exceeds the permitted maximum height. It depends on the as-built element, so it is not evaluated from lot data.

150.50.40.11(1).explanation: A lawfully existing place of worship may keep the lawful height of an architectural element such as a minaret or steeple, even when it exceeds the maximum building height.
